name: Refugio San Martín and Laguna Jakob
region: Nahuel Huapi National Park, Casa de Piedra valley
why: A long forest valley along the Casa de Piedra stream, then zigzags up to a stone hut on a mountain lake.
book: Book the hut ahead (it works only with bookings, open all year). Register your trek on the hut's online form. The trail starts at Tambo Báez on Ruta 79, 1 km past the Casa de Piedra bridge: paid parking, or bus to Bustillo km 10.5 and walk 5.8 km.
water: The Casa de Piedra stream runs beside most of the trail. Meals at the hut.
dangers: The last hour climbs steep zigzags ('los caracoles').
Snow near the lake until December.
Two stream crossings on bridges; side streams rise after rain.
turnaround: Not at the second bridge by 15:00: turn back, the hut is still 45 minutes up.

points.name: Tambo Báez trailhead, Casa de Piedra
points.note: Past the car park the path enters tall coihue forest and drops to the Casa de Piedra stream, crossed on a hanging bridge.

points.name: Laguna Jakob and Refugio San Martín
points.note: 1,564 m: the stone-and-wood hut on Laguna Jakob. Laguna Témpanos is 30 minutes further.
